name: StudEx Group — Workspace Index
description: Canonical register of StudEx Group operating assets, organised by business line. Single source of truth: WORKSPACE-INDEX.md, index.html and the /workspace route are all generated from this file.

location.workspace: Lives on the operator workstation under /workspace — not in this repository.
location.repo: Lives in this repository and is version-controlled here.

stage.ready: Complete and cleared to send or deploy; not yet fired.
stage.draft: Substantially built, needs a pass before it leaves the building.
stage.research: Intelligence and source material. Feeds other assets; not a deliverable itself.

conventions.restricted: Each is listed so it is accounted for; contents are deliberately not indexed and must never be committed to a public repository.
